recommendations.action: Replace hard threshold with continuous penalty
recommendations.reason: The entire similarity range is only 0.17 wide. A hard cut at any single value creates an artificial cliff in a dense region. A continuous sigmoid penalty would be more robust.
recommendations.expected_effect: Eliminates threshold arbitrariness. Evidence adjustment already provides data-driven softening.
